title: [finding] email_template: a Studio save of the same template in a second locale replaces the first locale's overlay at the next boot (sys_metadata keeps one overlay row per type and name)
body:
Filing gate, class (a): a reproducible defect, reach: a public door (`PUT /meta/email_template/...`), measured once on the showcase by the #15205 dev (report `6111776721`). Filed by the `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post #21118, `session_013LbZ9MhPp1iriZEtgJqioA`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader:** triage (grade and lane).

## What was measured

- Save `PUT /meta/email_template/NAME` with locale `en-US`, then save the same name with locale `zh-CN`. Both read back as saved.
- Restart. `en-US` serves the package wording again: `sys_metadata` keeps one overlay row per `(type, name)`, so the second locale's save replaced the first's.
- Pre-existing: the row path that #15205 stage 2 retires also reverted at boot. It is not introduced by PR #22875, and that PR does not fix it.

## Related, closed

- #7730 (a declared i18n bundle collided in the registry, keyed by name without locale), #21785 (a PUT overlay reverted at the next boot via the boot sweep), #7774 (a list merge deduped by package and name). Same family (locale is not part of an email template's overlay identity); this is the overlay-storage face.

## Done when

- Two locales of one email template, each saved through the metadata door, both survive a restart and each serves its own wording; CONTROL: a single-locale save is unchanged.

## Duplicate check

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed cards included: "email_template overlay locale reverts after restart sys_metadata one row per type name" → 8 hits, the related closed cards above; none is this storage face.
